In writing

The terms, before you ever pay

No contract appears after the sales call here — there is no sales call. These are the terms every York Digital engagement runs on, published where you can hold us to them.

  1. Demo first, freeWe build a working demo page for your business before you pay anything. Don’t like it? Walk away — there’s nothing to cancel.
  2. Published pricesThe prices on this page are the prices. If a price ever changes, existing clients hear it from us by email first — never by surprise on an invoice.
  3. Payment through StripeWhen you buy, you pay on Stripe’s checkout — never by e-transfer or cash to us. Stripe processes and holds the payment, and you get Stripe’s receipt for every charge.
  4. Cancel by emailOne email ends a Season Package. No exit interview, no retention script, no cancellation fee.
  5. You keep your pageIf you cancel, the page and its content stay yours. We don’t hold websites hostage.
  6. Your customers’ details are yoursEnquiries from your page go to your inbox. We don’t sell, share, or market to your customer list. Ever.
  7. Everything in writingAll communication is by email, so every promise either of us makes exists in a thread you can search. Nothing important is ever “just said on a call.”
  8. Replies within one business dayEmail us and you’ll hear back within one business day — usually much sooner.

Pricing

Two ways to pay. Both on this page.

All prices in Canadian dollars. No setup fee on either plan, and the demo is free before you choose one.

Season Package $249 /month for the season

One flat monthly price while your season runs. Best when enquiries are steady and you want costs predictable.

  • Your booking & quote page, live for the season
  • Instant estimate calculator with your prices
  • Every enquiry delivered to your inbox
  • Small text and price updates included
  • Cancel by email, any time
Pay per enquiry $30 /booking enquiry

Nothing monthly. You pay only when a customer actually sends a booking enquiry through your page.

  • Same page, same calculator
  • Charged only on real booking enquiries
  • Best for a first season or a slower month
  • Switch to the Season Package whenever it suits you
  • Cancel by email, any time

The honest math: at $30 an enquiry, the $249 Season Package pays for itself at about 8–9 enquiries a month. Expect fewer than that? Start per-enquiry and pay for results only. We’ll show you the same arithmetic — it’s your call, not our pitch.

How we work

New agency. Straight about it.

York Digital is a new business, and this page won’t pretend otherwise. What we have is finished work you can inspect and terms you can hold us to — so that’s what we lead with.

What you will never find here

  • ✕Fake reviews or testimonials. When real clients say something quotable, it goes up with their name and business attached — not before.
  • ✕Invented statistics. No “300% more leads” claims we can’t show the working for.
  • ✕Stock-photo handshakes and rented Lamborghinis. The photos on this page show the trades we build for — that’s all they claim to be.
  • ✕Pressure. No countdown timers, no “only 2 spots left,” no expiring-offer emails.
  • ✕Cold calls. We don’t phone businesses, and we won’t phone you. Email only — yours to answer when it suits you, or ignore.

How it works, start to finish

  1. You email usYour business name, your trade, your town. That’s all we need to start.
  2. We build your demo — freeA working booking page with your services and your prices, built before any payment is discussed.
  3. You check it like a customerRun the calculator, send a test enquiry, read every word. Ask for changes by email.
  4. Happy? Pick a plan and pay on Stripe’s checkoutYour page goes live on your own address. Enquiries start landing in your inbox — and you can cancel by email whenever you like.
